statement.zh: 已登记晚古风文献强调无陶，并报告建筑、垃圾、植物遗存与碳十四；未报道文字或泥板行政。
statement.en: Registered Late Archaic literature emphasizes aceramic assemblages and reports architecture, refuse, botanical remains, and radiocarbon; no writing or tablet administration reported.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
